findings.title: Axis axis at Indira Point
findings.message: 0 GBIF records of Axis axis within 500 km. Local survey data is thin (85 Mammalia records within 100 km), but the wider 500 km region is surveyed (513 Mammalia records) and has no records of this species. Possible range inconsistency flagged, verify.

findings.title: Rattus rattus: WPA schedule Sch-V
findings.message: Legal schedule may be outdated. Verify.

evidence.label: Source (authoritative, non-government)
evidence.value: The Bill reduces the total number of schedules to four by: (i) reducing the number of schedules for specially protected animals to two (one for greater protection level), (ii) removes the schedule for vermin species, and (iii) inserts a new schedule for specimens listed in the Appendices under CITES (scheduled specimens).

evidence.label: India Code / Gazette
evidence.value: Searched first (Tavily, restricted to indiacode.nic.in, egazette.gov.in); the results read do not state the number of schedules, so the next tier was used.

findings.why: Report lists Schedule Sch-V; https://prsindia.org/billtrack/the-wild-life-protection-amendment-bill-2021 (authoritative, non-government) says: "The Bill reduces the total number of schedules to four by: (i) reducing the number of schedules for specially protected animals to two (one for greater protection level), (ii) removes the schedule for vermin species, and (iii) inserts a new schedule for specimens listed in the Appendices under CITES (scheduled specimens)."
findings.clear: The species' schedule under the Wild Life (Protection) Act as amended in 2022.
